title: Kestrel and the Confession
author: Lior Hartwell
blurb: Kestrel Villalobos, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
